name: United Airlines
summary:
United Airlines’ site is united.com. The globe mark in the tab is the favicon for booking pages on that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against united.com. The homepage request ended as timeout, so discovery continued with icon paths. No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.united.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15406 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.
